descriptions.value: The Visual Form Builder WordPress plugin through 3.1 does not perform an authorization check before displaying recent form submission data in a dashboard widget, allowing any authenticated user (Subscriber and above) to read other users' submitted contact information, including names, email addresses, form titles and timestamps.

assertions.title: Visual Form Builder <= 3.1 - Subscriber+ Sensitive Data Disclosure via Dashboard Widget
